subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The method and practice of teaching
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pedagogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pedagogy"** refers to the method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept. (शिक्षाशास्त्र)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor specialized in pedagogy and developed innovative teaching strategies for her students.
 
 
 
• The correct word, **"Pedagogy"**, is widely used in the field of education to describe various teaching approaches and methodologies. (शिक्षा का तरीका)
 
 
• **Example:** Effective pedagogy requires understanding the diverse needs of students and tailoring teaching methods accordingly.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term "Pedagogy" accurately describes the method and practice of teaching.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pedagogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Objective** (लक्ष्य): A goal or purpose that one aims to achieve.

 
 
• **Example:** The objective of the workshop was to improve communication skills among employees.
 
 
 
• **Strategy** (रणनीति): A plan of action designed to achieve a specific goal.
 
 
• **Example:** The coach developed a new strategy to win the upcoming championship.
 
 
 
• **Learning** (सीखना): The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or teaching.
 
 
• **Example:** Continuous learning is essential for personal and professional growth.
